classification: Planetary Satellite (Target Destination — Mission 2 Lunar South Pole)
dataOriginNotice: Published planetary reference values from NASA NSSDCA Moon Fact Sheet, combined with measured LRO Diviner Polar Cumulative Products (PCP) bolometric temperatures at the Lunar South Pole.
pressureCategory: Hard surface-bounded exosphere (ultra-high vacuum, ~3 × 10⁻¹² mbar) — requires full pressure suit.

referenceTemperatureCelsius.note: South Polar values are directly measured by LRO Diviner PCP (PCP_AVG_TBOL_POLS_SUM_LTIM01_240). Non-polar regions do not have local Diviner PCP rasters in this bundle.

radiationEnvironment: No atmosphere and no global magnetic field; ~110–380 mSv/yr GCR exposure plus unattenuated solar flare protons (LRO CRaTER).
humanSafetyWarnings: The lunar exosphere provides negligible pressure and oxygen for humans. A pressurized life-support environment is required.
sourceCitation: NASA NSSDCA Moon Fact Sheet + LRO Diviner PCP (UCLA/PDS) + LRO LOLA GDR (NASA GSFC/MIT).
